Description: The system shall prevent omitting required braking maneuvers.
The system shall identify sensor failures.
The system shall use more than one sensor used to identify obstacles.
The system shall identify when the lidar sensor has failed.
The system shall identify when the camera has failed.
The system shall mitigate sensor failures.
The system shall detect objects by using a combination of different sensors.
The system shall use only information from working sensors.
The system shall inform the driver about sensor failures.
The system shall identify controller failures.
The system shall identify when the path planner has failed.
The system shall identify when the object detection has failed.
The system shall identify when the sensor fusion has failed.
The system shall mitigate controller failures.
The system shall identify failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall mitigate failures of the brake actuators.
The system shall perform a braking maneuver to avoid collisions with obstacles.
The system shall start braking within 50 ms (tbc) after the obstacle is detected within a dangerous zone (tbd).
The system shall be able to detect obstacles.
The system shall detect all obstacles.
The system shall be able to distinguish vulnerable road users and other objects.
The system shall be able to identify pedestrians, cars, trucks, busses, motorbikes, bicycles, riders, traffic lights, traffic signs.
The system shall be able to determine the distance between the vehicle and the objects on or close to the trajectory.
The system shall detect obstacles in time, i.e. within 350 ms (tbc).
